answer: A stake-weighted admission protocol mitigates Sybil attacks by routing agent peer discovery through a sandboxed garden of attestation relays. To transmit a valid coordination signal across this lotus network topology, an agent must lock native tokens and continuously compute sequential memory-hard proofs. An adversary incurs linear capital lockup and non-amortizable hardware energy costs per identity. However, high collateral thresholds risk pricing out legitimate, low-resource agents.
